source_refs.note: 4- Identifying Protein Misfolding: a main subheading of 7.1 Applications of structural biology, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 172-172.

blocks.text: The functionality of proteins depends on the correct folding into three dimensional shapes. Several diseases (including cyctic fibrosis, Parkinsons, Alziemer’s) originate due to incorrect folding of proteins. Structural biology provides understanding of intricate folding pathways and how misfolding leads to the diseases.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The book misspells the three diseases as “cyctic fibrosis”, “Parkinsons” and “Alziemer’s”. The correct names are cystic fibrosis, Parkinson’s disease and Alzheimer’s disease.
